label: CORPORATE SCANDAL
voice_script: Boeing called its 737 MAX the safest plane ever built. But a hidden software system, MCAS, relied on a single, tiny sensor. If that one sensor failed, the software would force the plane into a nosedive that pilots couldn't stop. That's what doomed Lion Air 610, with 189 dead. Five months later, it happened again: Ethiopian Airlines flight 302. 157 dead. The most shocking part? Boeing knew. Internal documents showed their own engineers warned them about the flaw. They sold the plane anyway.
